errata.objective: state the word and balanced chemical equation for photosynthesis
errata.verified_against: Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 syllabus for 2026-2028, p.17, subject content 6.1: '6CO2 + 6H2O → C6H12O6 + 6O2' (Syllabi/Cambridge Curricula/IGCSE Cambridge /IGCSE Biology 0610.pdf)
errata.check: Atoms balance only with 6H2O: left C6 H12 O18, right C6 H12 O18. With the printed 6HO2 the left has H6 O18 and does not balance.
